challenges.name: Yawning Chasm
challenges.description: A deep ravine splits the path. The other side's a stretch — but you might just make it.
challenges.successText: You clear it in one leap and roll to a stop!
challenges.failText: You slip at the edge — barely grab on and scramble up, all scraped up.

challenges.name: Sleeping Ogre
challenges.description: An ogre snoozes across the path, club in hand. Wake it and you're in trouble.
challenges.successText: You sneak by without a sound — still snoring.
challenges.failText: Snap! A twig gives you away and the ogre swats you, half-asleep.

challenges.name: Ancient Rune Gate
challenges.description: Glowing runes seal the way. Read them right... or get zapped.
challenges.successText: The runes shimmer and the gate melts away — path's open!
challenges.failText: Oops, wrong word — a jolt of magic zaps your head.
